name: The Weeper
visual_description: A squat creature, gelatinous and dimly luminescent. Its mouth hangs in eternal regret, eyes cavernous with witnessing.
meaning: Remorse embodied. Sadness with no catharsis.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh kept this as a pet once.** It mimicked mourning without knowing loss. But now... I think I carved it from my own memory. From what I erased.
